in_marathi.name: Sapan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sapan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sapan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sapna' which means dream or desire. It is also associated with the sky and the sun. In Hindu mythology, the god Indra is often depicted riding on a chariot drawn by horses named Sapanas, which suggests the name's connection to the sky and the sun.
